title: UTI After Sex
summary: A urinary tract infection causes burning when peeing, frequent urge and lower-belly pain. Sex can push bacteria toward the urethra; peeing after sex and staying hydrated can help prevent it.
key_points: UTIs usually need antibiotics; fever or back pain needs prompt care.
